follow-up time: Up to 5 years (COPSAC2010 cohort) and 13 years (COPSAC2000 cohort)
outcome: BMI at 6 months, 5 years, and 13 years
cohort: Term children from two birth cohorts: COPSAC2000 (n=393) and COPSAC2010 (n=673)
finding: While children born by cesarean section had higher BMI at 6 months, this difference did not persist into later childhood, suggesting that cesarean delivery alone does not lead to later overweight.
mod_finding: Children delivered by CD had a higher BMI at 6 months of age, but this difference did not track into later childhood.
